usedFor: Asyntai AI Chatbot answers visitor questions on your website, and Asana is where your team does the follow-up. A “New Human Help Request” in Asyntai can run “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana, assigning a person to the chat that the bot could not finish.

bestTemplate.name: “New Human Help Request” in Asyntai, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: This is the moment the chatbot hands a visitor to a person, and it needs an owner. “Create Task or Subtask” sets the assignee, dates, tags and description.

watchOut: “New Conversation Started” opens a task for every chat, so a busy site would fill Asana. “New Lead Captured” and “New Ticket Created” are narrower.
